title: Daily digest: Akshayakalpa Farms in Jubilee Hills fine | Bandi Sanjay Provides Rs 50,000 Assistan | Madras HC refuses to reject Anbil Mahesh | BJP Complains To Police Commissioner Ove
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: Akshayakalpa Farms in Jubilee Hills fined Rs 20k for wasting water.
Bandi Sanjay Provides Rs 50,000 Assistance To Ailing Boy’s Mother.
Madras HC refuses to reject Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi’s election petition.
BJP Complains To Police Commissioner Over Alleged Threat To Narayanaswamy.
bullets_ur: Jubilee Hills mein Akshayakalpa Farms par paani zaya karne par Rs 20k jurmana lagaya gaya
Bandi Sanjay ne beemar bachay ki walda ko 50,000 rupay ki imdad faraham kar di.
Madras HC ne Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi ki intikhabi darkhwast radd karne se inkaar kar diya
BJP ne Narayanaswamy ko milne wali mubayyanah dhamki par Police Commissioner se shikayat kar di
